```{r}
ggarrange(
  p_auto_ES_biomass_relative +
    rremove("xlab") + 
    labs(y = "Bioarea Density ES Relative"),
   p_hetero_ES_biomass_relative+
    rremove("xlab") +
    rremove("ylab") +
    labs(y = "Bioarea Density ES Relative"),
  p_auto_ES_biomass_70 +
    rremove("legend") +
    labs(y = "Bioarea Density ES 70"),
  p_hetero_ES_biomass_70 +
    rremove("ylab") +
    rremove("legend") +
    labs(y = "Bioarea Density ES 70"),
  nrow = 2,
  ncol = 2,
  align = "v"
)
```
